events.label: Lisa Demuth wins Minnesota Republican gubernatorial primary over Mike Lindell

slots.name: vote margin
slots.sentence: Lindell called for a recount after his primary loss to Minnesota state House Speaker Lisa Demuth (R), who won the Aug. 11 primary by 45,000 votes.

slots.name: winner
slots.sentence: Mike Lindell, the founder of MyPillow, lost the Republican primary race for governor to Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth.
